tui.sound.added: Added {name} ({id}), {seconds} seconds. Choose it with /sound use {id}.
tui.sound.added_selected: Added {name} ({id}), {seconds} seconds, and chose it as your notification sound.
tui.sound.disabled: Notification sounds off. Banners stay silent.
tui.sound.id_help: Plays as you arrow onto it. Add yours with /sound add; hearing two sounds? /sound doctor. `system` keeps your terminal's own sound.
tui.sound.not_found: There is no sound called {id}. Run /sound list to see your sounds.
tui.sound.preview_failed: Couldn't start the sound player. Run /sound doctor to see why.
tui.sound.preview_ssh: Nothing played: this is an SSH session, so the sound would play on the remote computer's speakers.
tui.sound.preview_system: `system` keeps your terminal's or system's own sound, so Local Operator plays nothing.
tui.sound.section_description: The sound played with a desktop notification, at most once every 1.5 seconds. Arrow through the list to hear each one, or use /sound.
tui.sound.slash: Notification sounds: list, preview, choose, add yours
tui.sound.usage: Use /sound list, preview [id], use <id>, volume <0-100>, on, off, add <file> [name] [--select], rename <id> <name>, remove <id> or doctor.
tui.sound.volume_range: Volume must be a whole number from 0 to 100.
